index.title: AI coding agents on your computer: what each one can do · RosmarOps Observatory
index.description: A dated record of security changes in AI coding agents that keep settings or keys on your computer. Every fact with its date, version and source.
index.h1: What each AI agent can do on your computer
index.lead: An AI agent works with your permissions. Here you can see what each one does by default without asking you (read your files, run programs, connect to other services) and how that changes from one version to the next. Every fact carries its date and its source, most of them from the maker's documentation or code. No one pays to appear here.
index.daily_line: We check the vendors' sources every day. What changed today is in the {link}.
index.agents_scope: Only agents that leave configuration, permissions or keys on your computer. Agents that run only in the cloud leave nothing there to read, so they aren't listed: {link}.
index.cloud_link: see how to review their access
index.pages_note: Only agents with content of their own have a page. The rest are listed here without a link until they have one.
index.status_note: Evaluated: RosmarOps gives it an Agent Posture Score on your computer, from 0 to 100. Detected: RosmarOps finds it on your computer but doesn't score it yet.
index.changes_daily: What we checked today, source by source, is in the {link}.
index.changes_empty: No security changes recorded yet. Each one will appear here with its date, version and official source.
index.method_p: Every fact comes with its source and the date it was checked, and each one is reviewed by hand before it is published. Nothing is deleted: corrections stay on record.
index.independence_p: No one pays to appear. Each vendor has a right of reply, published on its page without changing what we report.
index.data_p: Everything on this page is in JSON, with its source and its date.
index.tooling_note: Not agents: tools your agents use, which leave instructions, scripts or settings on your computer.

summary.cap.write_files.any_path.tools: edit files anywhere with its file tools
